title: Leap day
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: A day that doesn't count. Wood tells no one about the letter. He draws the strip on the back of the envelope it came in. The digest that week has a strip with a Portland address showing through.

panels.composition: The desk. The letter, opened Monday, pinned. The envelope, empty, flattened. WOOD drawing on its back. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man drawing a comic strip on the back of a flattened envelope at a desk, a letter pinned on the corkboard behind, a dog beneath, black and white, no words
image.notes: The PNCA letter pinned over the bus schedule per objects.md.

panels.composition: The envelope's back: four panels ruled in pencil, the paper's seams under them.

image.prompt: close on the back of a flattened envelope ruled into four comic panels in pencil, the paper's seams visible, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Held to the lamp: the front's address showing through backward. PORTLAND, mirrored, through panel two.

image.prompt: close on an envelope held to lamplight with a mirrored printed address showing faintly through a drawn panel, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood at the desk. The strip on the envelope done. Dated 2/29/00. A day that doesn't count, kept on paper that came from the place he said no to.

image.prompt: a young man at a desk holding a finished comic drawn on the back of an envelope up to the light, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Drawn on the envelope. 2/29/00. PORTLAND shows through panel two, mirrored.
